---
name: Bug report
about: Describe a reproducible runtime, module or tooling issue
---

## Observed and expected behavior

## Versions and environment

Source commit, module version, Android/WebView version, build variant and test scope.
Do not include private endpoints or personally identifying device metadata.

## Minimal reproduction

Use synthetic contacts/photos/data. Explain permissions, lifecycle or rotation involved.

## Verification

Which checks passed or failed? Attach only reviewed/redacted evidence, never signing
keys, credentials, private contacts or an entire raw diagnostics/results directory.

For a suspected vulnerability, use private reporting instead of this public issue:
https://github.com/blueworkslabs/construct/security/advisories/new
